description: Ingest in-memory content as a string (use ingest_file for files on disk). The source identifier enables re-ingestion to update existing content. Returns { filePath, chunkCount, timestamp, fileTitle }.

content.description: The content to ingest (text, HTML, or Markdown)

format.description: Content format: text (plain/copied text), html (fetched web pages), or markdown.

source.description: Source identifier. For web pages, use the URL (e.g., "https://example.com/page"). For other content, use URL-scheme format: "{type}://{date}" or "{type}://{date}/{detail}". Examples: "clipboard://2024-12-30", "chat://2024-12-30/project-discussion", "note://2024-12-30/meeting".

name: ingest_data
